mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to what is of benefit to the entire Christian community, to build it up."
An act of ministry refers to what is of benefit to the entire Christian community, to build it up.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fact that the expression gifts of healing is rendered in the plural."
Notable is the fact that the expression gifts of healing is rendered in the plural.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the vocation, privilege and responsibility of all baptized Christians."
Ministry is the vocation, privilege and responsibility of all baptized Christians.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an experience of being overcome with such a powerful emotion that a person's self control and reason is momentarily suspended."
Ecstasy is an experience of being overcome with such a powerful emotion that a person's self control and reason is momentarily suspended.
fib: ______ is the bedrock of all pastoral ministries.
Service of God and neighbour is the bedrock of all pastoral ministries.
______ is considered as a ministry on its own in the New Testament (1 Cor 12:28).
Pastoral administration is considered as a ministry on its own in the New Testament (1 Cor 12:28).
______ is the act of public proclamation of the good news of salvation.
Preaching is the act of public proclamation of the good news of salvation.
______ is used to exhort the presbyters (elders) in 1 Pet 5:1-4, "to tend the flock of God" in their charge, and to "be examples to the flock".
The same shepherd image is used to exhort the presbyters (elders) in 1 Pet 5:1-4, "to tend the flock of God" in their charge, and to "be examples to the flock".
